layouts.statement: Centered slide, no <wb-title>: one sentence or number.
layouts.title-body: <wb-title> plus one or two short paragraphs.
layouts.title-image: <wb-title> plus one <wb-image> and a one-line caption.

title.name: Title
title.purpose: Name the talk and who it is for.

hook.name: Hook
hook.purpose: Earn attention in one beat: a surprising fact, question or image.

agenda.name: Agenda
agenda.purpose: Preview the path so the audience can follow it.

bluf.name: Bottom line
bluf.purpose: State the conclusion or decision needed up front.

situation.name: Situation
situation.purpose: Describe the stable, agreed starting point.

complication.name: Complication
complication.purpose: Show what changed or what threatens the situation.

question.name: Question
question.purpose: Make explicit the question the audience now holds.

answer.name: Answer
answer.purpose: Give the governing thought that answers the question.

argument.name: Supporting argument
argument.purpose: One key line under the answer, stated as a full-sentence claim.

evidence.name: Evidence
evidence.purpose: Data, example or source that proves the claim in the title.

problem.name: Problem
problem.purpose: Name the pain concretely, from the audience's side.

stakes.name: Stakes
stakes.purpose: Show the cost of doing nothing.

current-state.name: What is
current-state.purpose: Describe today as the audience knows it.

future-state.name: What could be
future-state.purpose: Describe the better world the idea makes possible.

contrast.name: Contrast
contrast.purpose: Put before and after, or us and them, side by side.

solution.name: Solution
solution.purpose: Introduce the idea, product or change that resolves the problem.

how-it-works.name: How it works
how-it-works.purpose: Show the mechanism in a few steps.

benefit.name: Benefit
benefit.purpose: Translate features into outcomes the audience values.

options.name: Options
options.purpose: Lay out 2-3 real alternatives with trade-offs.

recommendation.name: Recommendation
recommendation.purpose: Pick one option and say why.

risk.name: Risks
risk.purpose: Name what could go wrong and how it is handled.

plan.name: Plan
plan.purpose: Show the steps, owners and timing.

ask.name: Ask
ask.purpose: Request one specific action, decision or resource.

story.name: Story beat
story.purpose: Advance a narrative with a character, a moment and a change.

character.name: Character
character.purpose: Introduce the person the audience will root for.

turning-point.name: Turning point
turning-point.purpose: The moment things change; the emotional peak.

resolution.name: Resolution
resolution.purpose: Show the new normal after the change.

data-point.name: Key number
data-point.purpose: One number, big, with what it means.

market.name: Market
market.purpose: Size and shape of the opportunity.

traction.name: Traction
traction.purpose: Proof that it is already working.

competition.name: Competition
competition.purpose: Where this sits against alternatives and why it wins.

recap.name: Recap
recap.purpose: Repeat the few points to remember.

close.name: Close
close.purpose: End on the main message or a memorable line.
